topic: Design the ideal space station recreation room

scenario.topic: Design the ideal space station recreation room
scenario.opening_question: What matters most when designing the ideal space station recreation room: entertainment options, physical activity spaces, social areas, or mental wellness features?

options.name: Galactic Gym
options.upside: Improves physical health and reduces muscle atrophy in microgravity environments.
options.tradeoff: Takes up a significant amount of space and requires ongoing staffing costs.
options.concern: May not cater to astronauts with disabilities or injuries.

options.name: Stellar Lounge

attrs.entertainment_options: Virtual reality experiences and movie nights

options.upside: Fosters social connections and relaxation among crew members.
options.tradeoff: May not provide enough physical activity options.
options.concern: Could become a distraction or source of noise pollution.
options.best_for: Astronauts valuing social interaction and leisure time.

options.name: Mindful Oasis
options.upside: Supports mental wellness and stress reduction.
options.tradeoff: May not appeal to astronauts who prefer more active pursuits.
options.concern: Could be underutilized if not properly promoted.
options.best_for: Astronauts prioritizing mental health and self-care.

options.name: Cosmic Playground

attrs.activity_options: Zero-gravity sports, puzzle rooms, and arcade games

options.upside: Offers a unique and engaging entertainment experience.
options.tradeoff: Requires significant space and equipment investments.
options.concern: May be too noisy or chaotic for some crew members.
options.best_for: Astronauts seeking fun and novel experiences.

shared_context: The space station has a total of 1000 square meters available for the recreation room.
The room will be used by a crew of 20 astronauts who will be on the station for at least 6 months.
The budget for the recreation room is $500,000.

Option C - Mindful Oasis: space allocation 200 square meters, soundproofing cost $50,000, wellness programs Meditation classes and yoga sessions
Option D - Cosmic Playground: space allocation 400 square meters, equipment cost $200,000, activity options Zero-gravity sports, puzzle rooms, and arcade games
